survey: An open paper envelope, tilted slightly and facing the camera, holding a fanned stack of about four photo prints. Envelope: the open top flap stands up behind the photos and peeks out above them. The front pocket is built from the usual side and bottom flaps; their diagonal fold lines meet in a shallow V, and the pocket edge curves over the photos. A postage stamp with a house symbol sits on the lower right of the front, and a round postmark with wavy cancel lines overlaps it. Photos: white-bordered prints that sit inside the pocket, between the front and the back panel, and fan out above the opening. The front print shows a coastal village, and the prints behind it show blue and pink edges. Their lower parts are hidden by the front of the pocket, so they are held by it. Nothing floats: the prints rest inside the envelope, and the envelope is the only object on a plain background.
